roadmap.goal: ADO Bug #6458 (a): the To Do, Doing and Done lists hold raw tracker states and a state mapping is a derived display grouping. One entry classifier on the owner normalises every write and every read; a shadowing payload is a 400; a startup seeder rewrites stored lists once (skip and log); the settings page shows a mapping as one chip it cannot remove, and the aging chart never shows an empty Doing list while its settings load or fail.
roadmap.scope: Backend: owner model (classifier, normaliser, display view, split category lookup), settings sync and validators, settings DTO, new seeder, connectors (ADO, Jira issue factory, ServiceNow, CSV demo journey), metrics services, suggestions endpoint. Frontend: display view and shared fold, validation mirror, StatesList chips, editor help text, metrics pages and the aging frame; the reconciliation module is deleted. No schema change, no migration, no new package.
ssot_inputs: docs/feature/bug-6458-typed-category-entries/feature-delta.md (DESIGN D1-D12, components, Reuse Analysis, UI1-UI8, DISTILL scenario inventory and slice order)
roadmap.rigor_profile: thorough (agreed with the maintainer at AFK entry): crafter opus, reviewer sonnet, double review. Pass model explicitly on every dispatch.
roadmap.slice_order_note: DISTILL order kept. Under D12 the read switch (phase 04) no longer depends on stored data being raw, so it could move before the write path, but its HTTP read scenarios need the DTO display lists from phase 02 and the seeder phase proves the normaliser is the identity on rewritten rows; moving it buys nothing.
standing_rules: Un-skip only the scenarios a step names: remove `[Ignore("pending: ...")]` on NUnit methods and `it.skip` (and its pending-reason comment) in Vitest. Every phase ends with every un-skipped test passing and the still-pending ones still skipped.

Focused runs only: backend `dotnet build` then `dotnet test --filter "FullyQualifiedName~<ClassName>"`; frontend `pnpm vitest run <files>`. Never the unfiltered `dotnet test` (live connector categories hit real trackers).
The machine is loaded by a parallel mutation-testing session: never run backend and frontend suites concurrently.

Phase-end gate, backend: `dotnet build` (zero warnings), then `dotnet test --filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"`. Frontend: `pnpm test`, then `pnpm build` (prebuild runs `biome check --write`; check git status afterwards). Known environmental failures (2 Licensing in a worktree, ReleaseService contention) are listed in CLAUDE.md and are not regressions.

Remove each `// SCAFFOLD: true` / `__SCAFFOLD__` / doc-comment `SCAFFOLD: true` marker in the step that implements its member. `grep -rn "SCAFFOLD: true\|__SCAFFOLD__" Lighthouse.Backend Lighthouse.Frontend/src` must find nothing in production code after 05-08.
Comments: plain-language why only; never cite D-numbers, UI-numbers, ADR numbers or slice ids. No nWave scenario tags in code.

Copy is pinned exactly: Doing shadowing `Mapping "{name}" has the same name as the Doing state "{state}". Add "{name}" to this mapping to group it, or choose another name.`; To Do/Done shadowing `Mapping "{name}" has the same name as the {To Do|Done} state "{state}". Choose another name.`; chain `Mapping "{name}" has the same name as a state grouped by mapping "{other}". Choose another name.`; UI7 category sentences as in feature-delta.md. UI7 wording still needs the maintainer's explicit yes at the first review window.
Pre-apply docs/ci-learnings.md for the stack touched. Commits: conventional, scope `state-mapping`, one focused commit per step, refactor commits apart. Do NOT push without the maintainer.
out_of_scope: Release-note lines (written at /release): v1 meaning change of doingStates and the shadowing 400; old settings page re-collapses after a downgrade; an owner in the seeder's Warning keeps working and is retried; rolling-update overlap with more than one replica.
